استحرموا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْرَمُوا (istaḥramū) /is.taħ.ra.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اُسْتُحْرِمُوا (ustuḥrimū) /us.tuħ.ri.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرِمُوا (istaḥrimū) /is.taħ.ri.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
